lines.say: Are you doing biceps curls wrong?
Your biceps does two jobs. It bends your elbow, and it turns your palm up.
So curl with your palms facing up. Turn them sideways, and other arm muscles take over more of the work.
The most common mistake: swinging. Your back and hips lift the weight, not your biceps.
Keep your elbows still at your sides. Lift, squeeze, and lower slowly.
And don't skip the bottom. The stretched part of the rep looks especially good for growth.
If you have to swing it, it's too heavy.
